name: Bornholm
shape: Eurostat NUTS, the area it is named for

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Too cool for most classic wine grapes. Only very early ripening ones do well here.
Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

sources.name: Fick and Hijmans 2017, WorldClim 2.1 monthly averages for 1970 to 2000, 2.5 minute grid (about 4.5 km)

Winkler, Cook, Kliewer and Lider 1974, General Viticulture, University of California Press (heat summation regions)
Jones 2010, Climate, grapes, and wine: structure and suitability in a variable and changing climate, VIII International Terroir Congress (which grapes suit which growing season temperatures)
ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0, 1 km aggregates, 30 to 60 cm depth (CC BY 4.0)
